document_title: PITCHMIND Data Rights and Permissions Register
governing_policy: Rights-Based Video Footage & Open Research Data Framework (ADR 002)

entries.name: SkillCorner Open Data (10 A-League Matches)
entries.permitted_use: Internal research, canonical adapter development, feature engineering, and model training.
entries.attribution_text: Data provided by SkillCorner under MIT License. Open Data initiative.
entries.notes: 10 Hz broadcast-derived tracking; includes detected and extrapolated flags.

entries.name: IDSSE Tracking and Event Dataset
entries.permitted_use: Cross-provider transfer evaluation (Ablation E7) and coordinate normalization testing.
entries.attribution_text: IDSSE Dataset provided under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
entries.notes: 25 FPS optical tracking downsampled to 10 Hz canonical analytical grid.

entries.name: Metrica Sports Sample Tracking Data
entries.permitted_use: Sanity checks for coordinate normalization, adapter unit tests, and replay prototyping.
entries.attribution_text: Sample data courtesy of Metrica Sports.
entries.notes: No LICENSE file confirmed in repository root. Redistribution strictly prohibited without explicit license.

entries.name: SoccerNet Multi-Object Tracking Benchmark
entries.license: Academic Benchmark Terms (Devkit code unverified at root)
entries.permitted_use: Computer-vision detection and multi-object tracking benchmarking (HOTA metric).
entries.notes: Access governed by SoccerNet benchmark challenge conditions.

entries.name: SoccerNet Group Activity Recognition (GAR)
entries.attribution_text: SoccerNet-GAR under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International.
entries.notes: Strict non-commercial restriction. Cannot be used for commercial product deployment.

entries.name: SkillCorner Open Data Body Pose (Pilot)
entries.permitted_use: SCAN2PLAY feasibility pilot and pre-reception orientation proxy research.
entries.attribution_text: SkillCorner Body Pose Open Data under MIT License.
entries.notes: Initial two-match pilot release; 29 joints; pose present only for detected players.
